messages:
Anna PM: Heads up — we need to finalize the partner SEV bridge roles + runner rotation for CloudVendor marketplace launch on Tue 2026-03-31. Proposal below, need signoff and channel map.
Keisha Gomez: Ack. Can you paste the proposed rotations & which channels are canonical?
Anna PM: Quick proposal: short rotations (24h) for the first week, then 12/12 for peak. Primary bridge = PartnersOnCall, secondary = eng-oncall, tertiary = eng-sre.
Ryan (SRE): 24h sounds fine for week-of-launch but we need a named runner for midnight handoffs. Suggest creating a separate runner role ("bridge-runner") whose job is handoffs & incident comms.
Evan - Partners Ops: Agreed. Runner should be on the shared channel and have perms to create the private war room. Also propose a single shared channel for triage: #cv-partners-triage (read/write for partner reps, eng leads, ops).
Anna PM: Channel naming convention proposal: #cv-partners-triage (open), #cv-sev-bridge (private, ops+oncall+partner liaisons), #cv-announcements (read-only).
Jasper: +1 on naming. Also add a short checklist for when bridge is created: 1) post incident template, 2) invite partner rep, 3) confirm escalation path.
Anna PM: Posting suggested checklist snippet: ```
Bridge checklist:
- Create war room: /warroom create cv-launch
- Invite: @PartnersOnCall, @eng-oncall, @Ryan (SRE), partner rep
- Post initial incident template (severity, impact, owner, ETA)
- Soc/Legal notified if data-sensitive
```
Keisha Gomez: Where does the partner's SE contact live? We should avoid DM chains. propose adding them to #cv-partners-triage with read-only and have partner rep in private bridge.
Evan - Partners Ops: Partner SEs get read/write in #cv-partners-triage, partner liaisons in #cv-sev-bridge. That keeps public comms accessible and private troubleshooting in bridge.
Ryan (SRE): Escalation flow: PartnersOnCall -> eng-oncall (15m SLA) -> eng-sre (1h SLA) -> exec pager (3h). Put that in the runbook.
Tom Li: Minor ask: can we automate rotation reminders? PagerDuty/Slack integration to DM runner 1hr before shift ends.
Anna PM: Yes — add automation line in runbook: `PD -> Slack DM` and a pinned rota in #cv-sev-bridge.
IncidentsBot: War room created: https://warroom.internal/1972109876 (private). Creator: Anna PM
PartnersOnCall: Joined the channel.
Keisha Gomez: LGTM from my side. I'll own day-1 bridge-runner and notify partner SEs.
Ryan (SRE): I'll take day-2 and own the automation ticket (PD integration).
Tom Li: I'll draft the runbook doc and share link in thread by EOD.
Jasper: I'll update the partnership runbook with the channel map and checklist.
Anna PM: Thanks — if no objections by EOD I'll roll this into the official launch runbook and create the PD schedules. :thumbsup:
Keisha Gomez: No objections, go ahead.
Tom Li: Runbook link: https://docs.internal/reports/cv-launch-runbook (draft)
Anna PM: Closing loop — will create rotation calendar and post final in #cv-announcements tomorrow morning.
Ryan (SRE): Noted. I'll verify PD->Slack reminders before EOD tomorrow.
Anna PM: Thanks everyone — feel free to ping me if you spot gaps.
